h1: A Google Sheets AI agent that keeps your sheet up to date for you

You describe the job to Captain in one sentence, check the plan it shows, and it runs on its own against your sheet.

faqs.q: Can an AI agent update several rows in Google Sheets at once?
faqs.a: Yes. “Update Multiple Rows” changes the rows you name in one step, and “Batch Update Cell Values” sets many cells at once. Say which column and which rows in the ask, and check Captain's plan before you approve it.

faqs.q: How do I stop it adding a duplicate row or changing the wrong one?
faqs.a: Ask it to find the row first. “Lookup Spreadsheet Rows” matches a value such as an order number, and “Update Spreadsheet Row” changes only that row. Use “Add New Row to Sheet” only when the record is new.

faqs.q: Does a new row in my sheet start the work straight away?
faqs.a: “Row Added Or Updated” starts an automation or an AI agent when a row is added or edited. It fires on edits too, so plan for a row that changes twice, for example by checking a Status column first.

faqs.q: How is this different from AI add-ons and Gemini inside Google Sheets?
faqs.a: Add-ons and in-sheet AI help with the cells in the file you have open. On 50agents the sheet is one of your apps, so the work can start in Gmail, Stripe, Shopify or a form, read or write the sheet with “List Rows in Sheet” or “Add New Row to Sheet”, and finish in Slack or an email.

faqs.q: Can an AI agent read my sheet and answer questions about it?
faqs.a: Yes. It reads rows with “List Rows in Sheet”, “Get Rows From Range” or “Lookup Spreadsheet Rows” and answers in its chat or on a schedule. Writing back is a step you name, such as “Update Spreadsheet Row”.

faqs.q: Can it make a new tab or sheet for each month or client?
faqs.a: Yes. “Create Subsheet” adds a tab, “Create a Spreadsheet” and “Create Spreadsheet From Template” make a new file, and “Copy Sheet To Spreadsheet” copies a tab into another file.

faqs.q: Can it delete rows or clear data?
faqs.a: The catalog has “Delete Rows”, “Clear Spreadsheet Row” and “Permanently Delete Spreadsheet”. Changes made in Google Sheets cannot be undone from 50agents, so name a delete in the ask only when you mean it, and ask for an approval step first.
